sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: Uma Molécula que Veio da Carne
subtitle: Por que baleias, galgos e peito de frango carregam o tampão que o humano tem pouco?
content:
[[COMP:CarnosineOriginSim]]

Fontes

  • Boldyrev AA, Aldini G, Derave W. Physiology and pathophysiology of carnosine. Physiol Rev 2013;93(4):1803-45. — descoberta em 1900 como composto nitrogenado não proteico da carne; funções propostas; o tampão é a de melhor suporte em humanos.
  • Drozak J, Veiga-da-Cunha M, Vertommen D, et al. Molecular identification of carnosine synthase as ATP-grasp domain-containing protein 1 (ATPGD1). J Biol Chem 2010;285(13):9346-56. — a CARNS1 só ganhou identidade molecular em 2010.
  • Dolan E, Saunders B, Harris RC, et al. Comparative physiology investigations support a role for histidine-containing dipeptides in intracellular acid-base regulation of skeletal muscle. Comp Biochem Physiol A Mol Integr Physiol 2019;234:77-86. — baleias, cavalos de corrida, galgos e aves de músculo branco ricos em dipeptídeos de histidina.
  • Harris RC, Marlin DJ, Dunnett M, Snow DH, Hultman E. Muscle buffering capacity and dipeptide content in the thoroughbred horse, greyhound dog and man. Comp Biochem Physiol A 1990;97(2):249-51. — tampão muscular maior em cavalo e cão, sobretudo por dipeptídeos de histidina.
  • Mannion AF, Jakeman PM, Dunnett M, Harris RC, Willan PL. Carnosine and anserine concentrations in the quadriceps femoris muscle of healthy humans. Eur J Appl Physiol Occup Physiol 1992;64(1):47-50. — 20,0 mmol/kg ms (7,2–30,7); homens 21,3 × mulheres 17,5; anserina indetectável.
  • Baguet A, Everaert I, Hespel P, et al. A new method for non-invasive estimation of human muscle fiber type composition. PLoS One 2011;6(7):e21956. — explosivos ~30% acima, fundistas ~20% abaixo da referência.
  • Everaert I, Mooyaart A, Baguet A, et al. Vegetarianism, female gender and increasing age, but not CNDP1 genotype, are associated with reduced muscle carnosine levels in humans. Amino Acids 2011;40(4):1221-9. — variação de até 4×; vegetarianos −26% no gastrocnêmio; homens +36/+28/+82%; queda com a idade no sóleo. Barras do slide: cálculo a partir dessas diferenças.
  • Blancquaert L, Baguet A, Bex T, et al. Changing to a vegetarian diet reduces the body creatine pool in omnivorous women, but appears not to affect carnitine and carnosine homeostasis: a randomised trial. Br J Nutr 2018;119(7):759-70. — 6 meses de dieta vegetariana não mudaram a carnosina.
  • Rezende NS, Bestetti GC, Farias de Oliveira L, et al. Dietary β-alanine intake assessed by food records does not associate with muscle carnosine content in healthy, active, omnivorous men and women. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2023;33(3):133-40. — sem associação entre β-alanina da dieta e carnosina.
  • Bianca é personagem fictícia composta para ensino (dossiê 06, Parte 5).

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: β-alanina + Histidina = Carnosina
subtitle: O músculo monta o tampão; engolir a peça pronta não pula a montagem.
content:
[[COMP:CarnosineChemSim]]

Fontes

  • Drozak J, Veiga-da-Cunha M, Vertommen D, et al. Molecular identification of carnosine synthase as ATP-grasp domain-containing protein 1 (ATPGD1). J Biol Chem 2010;285(13):9346-56. — CARNS1 (ATP-grasp): ATP → ADP.
  • Sale C, Saunders B, Harris RC. Effect of beta-alanine supplementation on muscle carnosine concentrations and exercise performance. Amino Acids 2010;39(2):321-33. — pKa do imidazol 6,83; a β-alanina é o fator limitante. Fração protonada no slide: cálculo por Henderson–Hasselbalch.
  • Blancquaert L, Everaert I, Missinne M, et al. Effects of histidine and β-alanine supplementation on human muscle carnosine storage. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2017;49(3):602-9. — histidina 3,5 g/dia por 23 dias não mudou a carnosina.
  • Mannion AF, Jakeman PM, Dunnett M, Harris RC, Willan PL. Carnosine and anserine concentrations in the quadriceps femoris muscle of healthy humans. Eur J Appl Physiol Occup Physiol 1992;64(1):47-50. — ~7% da capacidade tamponante muscular.
  • de Jager S, Vermeulen A, De Baere S, et al. Acute balenine supplementation in humans as a natural carnosinase-resistant alternative to carnosine. Sci Rep 2023;13(1):6484. — meia-vida no plasma: carnosina 1,20 min, anserina 2,14 min, balenina 34,9 min. Restante em 5 min: cálculo.
  • Harris RC, Tallon MJ, Dunnett M, et al. The absorption of orally supplied beta-alanine and its effect on muscle carnosine synthesis in human vastus lateralis. Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89. — +42,1% (3,2 g/d), +64,2% (6,4 g/d), +65,8% (L-carnosina isomolar) em 4 semanas; caldo de galinha: β-alanina 428 µM no plasma, sem carnosina.

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: Encher o Tanque Leva Semanas
subtitle: O que manda é a dose acumulada, e o rótulo brasileiro muda o relógio.
content:
[[COMP:CarnosineLoadingSim]]

Fontes

  • Rezende NS, Swinton P, de Oliveira LF, et al. The muscle carnosine response to beta-alanine supplementation: a systematic review with Bayesian individual and aggregate data E-max model and meta-analysis. Front Physiol 2020;11:913. — ED50 = 377 g de dose cumulativa; 99,3% respondem. A curva do slide é um modelo ilustrativo com essa forma (fração do teto = D / (377 + D)).
  • Harris RC, Tallon MJ, Dunnett M, et al. The absorption of orally supplied beta-alanine and its effect on muscle carnosine synthesis in human vastus lateralis. Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89. — +42,1% e +64,2% em 4 semanas com 3,2 e 6,4 g/dia.
  • Hill CA, Harris RC, Kim HJ, et al. Influence of beta-alanine supplementation on skeletal muscle carnosine concentrations and high intensity cycling capacity. Amino Acids 2007;32(2):225-33. — +58,8% (4 sem) e +80,1% (10 sem).
  • Stegen S, Blancquaert L, Everaert I, et al. Meal and beta-alanine coingestion enhances muscle carnosine loading. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2013;45(8):1478-85. — ~3% incorporado à carnosina; +64% com refeição × +41% entre refeições. Gramas que viram carnosina: cálculo.
  • Stellingwerff T, Anwander H, Egger A, et al. Effect of two β-alanine dosing protocols on muscle carnosine synthesis and washout. Amino Acids 2012;42(6):2461-72. — washout ~2%/semana; dose cumulativa manda.
  • Baguet A, Reyngoudt H, Pottier A, et al. Carnosine loading and washout in human skeletal muscles. J Appl Physiol 2009;106(3):837-42. — volta ao basal em 9 semanas (média), 6 a 15 semanas. O washout do slide é calibrado nesse estudo (ilustrativo).
  • Hobson RM, Saunders B, Ball G, Harris RC, Sale C. Effects of β-alanine supplementation on exercise performance: a meta-analysis. Amino Acids 2012;43(1):25-37. — mediana de 179 g de β-alanina total.
  • Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária. Instrução Normativa nº 28/2018 (com a IN 102/2021). — β-alanina até 2 g/dia, doses de até 300 mg a cada 2 h, ≥19 anos. ~90 dias × 28 dias para 179 g: cálculo (dossiê 06).

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: O Homem da Creatina
subtitle: O mesmo cientista encheu o músculo de creatina em dias e de carnosina em semanas, e patenteou a ideia.
content:
[[COMP:HarrisStorySim]]

Fontes

  • Australian Institute of Sport. AIS Sports Supplement Framework — Group A. https://www.ais.gov.au/nutrition/supplements/group_a (acesso 04/11/2026). — Roger Harris, que também liderou os estudos originais de creatina.
  • Harris RC, Söderlund K, Hultman E. Elevation of creatine in resting and exercised muscle of normal subjects by creatine supplementation. Clin Sci 1992;83(3):367-74. — 5 g, 4–6×/dia, ≥2 dias; 5 g = creatina de 1,1 kg de bife cru.
  • Dunnett M, Harris RC. Influence of oral beta-alanine and L-histidine supplementation on the carnosine content of the gluteus medius. Equine Vet J Suppl 1999;(30):499-504. — 6 puro-sangues, 100 mg/kg de β-alanina + 12,5 mg/kg de histidina, 3×/dia, 30 dias.
  • Harris RC, Dunnett M. Methods and compositions for increasing the anaerobic working capacity in tissue. Patente US 5,965,596 (depósito 12/08/1997; concessão 12/10/1999; cessionária atual: Natural Alternatives International). — 6 pessoas sem mudança aparente de carnosina no estudo humano descrito.
  • Harris RC, Tallon MJ, Dunnett M, et al. The absorption of orally supplied beta-alanine and its effect on muscle carnosine synthesis in human vastus lateralis. Amino Acids 2006;30(3):279-89. — estudo de Chichester; coautor da NAI.
  • Hill CA, Harris RC, Kim HJ, et al. Influence of beta-alanine supplementation on skeletal muscle carnosine concentrations and high intensity cycling capacity. Amino Acids 2007;32(2):225-33. — +13,0% de trabalho no teste a 110%.
  • del Favero S, Roschel H, Solis MY, et al. Beta-alanine (Carnosyn™) supplementation in elderly subjects (60-80 years): effects on muscle carnosine content and physical capacity. Amino Acids 2012;43(1):49-56. — declaração de conflitos (inventor, consultor, financiamento parcial e insumos da NAI).
  • Rezende NS, Swinton P, de Oliveira LF, et al. Front Physiol 2020;11:913. — teto do modelo usado no quadro creatina × carnosina (ilustrativo).

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: O Formigamento
subtitle: Formigar mostra quão rápido a β-alanina subiu no sangue, não quanto chegou ao músculo.
content:
[[COMP:ParesthesiaSim]]

Fontes

  • Décombaz J, Beaumont M, Vuichoud J, Bouisset F, Stellingwerff T. Effect of slow-release β-alanine tablets on absorption kinetics and paresthesia. Amino Acids 2012;43(1):67-76. — 1,6 g: pico 248 µM (pura, 0,5 h) × 82 µM (lenta, 1 h); AUC igual; sintomas com liberação lenta iguais ao placebo; >800 mg costuma formigar. Forma das curvas e posição do limiar: ilustrativas.
  • Shinohara T, Harada M, Ogi K, et al. Identification of a G protein-coupled receptor specifically responsive to beta-alanine. J Biol Chem 2004;279(22):23559-64. — TGR7/MrgD responde à β-alanina em µM; gânglio da raiz dorsal.
  • Liu Q, Sikand P, Ma C, et al. Mechanisms of itch evoked by β-alanine. J Neurosci 2012;32(42):14532-7. — coceira depende de MrgprD; sem histamina; em humanos, sem pápula nem eritema.
  • Wang C, Gu L, Ruan Y, et al. Facilitation of MrgprD by TRP-A1 promotes neuropathic pain. FASEB J 2019;33(1):1360-73. — cascata MrgprD → PKA → TRPA1 (camundongo).
  • Dolan E, Swinton PA, Painelli VS, et al. A systematic risk assessment and meta-analysis on the use of oral β-alanine supplementation. Adv Nutr 2019;10(3):452-63. — parestesia OR 8,9 (2,2–32,6); abandono igual; ALT dentro da referência; taurina muscular sem efeito.
  • Artioli GG, Gualano B, Smith A, Stout J, Lancha AH. Role of beta-alanine supplementation on muscle carnosine and exercise performance. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2010;42(6):1162-73. — parestesia com dose única >800 mg.
  • Trexler ET, Smith-Ryan AE, Stout JR, et al. International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: Beta-Alanine. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2015;12:30. — doses fracionadas de até 1,6 g ou liberação lenta.
  • Maughan RJ, Burke LM, Dvorak J, et al. IOC consensus statement: dietary supplements and the high-performance athlete. Br J Sports Med 2018;52(7):439-55. — 0,8–1,6 g a cada 3–4 h.
  • Stegen S, Blancquaert L, Everaert I, et al. Meal and beta-alanine coingestion enhances muscle carnosine loading. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2013;45(8):1478-85. — liberação lenta carrega como a pura.

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: O que Dizem 40 Ensaios
subtitle: Efeito pequeno no geral, claro na capacidade, incerto no desempenho de prova.
content:
[[COMP:BetaAlanineForestSim]]

Fontes

  • Saunders B, Elliott-Sale K, Artioli GG, et al. β-alanine supplementation to improve exercise capacity and performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Br J Sports Med 2017;51(8):658-69. — 40 estudos, 1.461 participantes; ES 0,18 (0,08–0,28); capacidade 0,50 (0,246–0,753) × desempenho 0,11 (−0,201 a 0,416); dose total não moderou (p=0,438).
  • de Oliveira LF, Dolan E, Swinton PA, et al. Extracellular buffering supplements to improve exercise capacity and performance: a comprehensive systematic review and meta-analysis. Sports Med 2022;52(3):505-26. — bicarbonato ES 0,17 (189 artigos), para comparação.
  • Hobson RM, Saunders B, Ball G, Harris RC, Sale C. Effects of β-alanine supplementation on exercise performance: a meta-analysis. Amino Acids 2012;43(1):25-37. — <60 s sem efeito (P=0,312); mediana +2,85% com 179 g (métrica de medianas, fora do forest).
  • Liang W, Kong D, Wang Y, et al. No ergogenic effect of β-alanine on repeated sprint ability: a systematic review and multilevel meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Front Nutr 2026;13:1818755. — 17 ECR; SMD −0,018 (−0,207 a 0,170).
  • Chung W, Baguet A, Bex T, Bishop DJ, Derave W. Doubling of muscle carnosine concentration does not improve laboratory 1-hr cycling time-trial performance. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2014;24(3):315-24. — carnosina +143–161%, contrarrelógio de 1 h sem efeito.
  • Kendrick IP, Harris RC, Kim HJ, et al. The effects of 10 weeks of resistance training combined with beta-alanine supplementation on whole body strength, force production, muscular endurance and body composition. Amino Acids 2008;34(4):547-54. — força e composição sem efeito.
  • Ashtary-Larky D, Bagheri R, Ghanavati M, et al. Effects of beta-alanine supplementation on body composition: a GRADE-assessed systematic review and meta-analysis. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2022;19(1):196-218. — 20 estudos; MLG +0,05 kg (−0,71 a 0,82), I²=0%.

sectionName: Ato IV · A Segunda Testemunha: Beta-alanina
title: Os "Quases" da Elite
subtitle: Significância não é relevância, e um nulo pode virar manchete.
content:
[[COMP:EliteNearMissSim]]

Fontes

  • Derave W, Ozdemir MS, Harris RC, et al. beta-Alanine supplementation augments muscle carnosine content and attenuates fatigue during repeated isokinetic contraction bouts in trained sprinters. J Appl Physiol 2007;103(5):1736-43. — 15 velocistas, 4,8 g/d por 4 sem; carnosina +47% sóleo, +37% gastrocnêmio (placebo +16%); 400 m sem efeito.
  • Baguet A, Bourgois J, Vanhee L, Achten E, Derave W. Important role of muscle carnosine in rowing performance. J Appl Physiol 2010;109(4):1096-101. — 5 g/d por 7 sem; 4,3 s mais rápido no 2.000 m (antes 0,3 s mais lento), P=0,07; r=0,498. IC95% e cenário com outro n: cálculo ilustrativo a partir do P publicado (8 × 9 analisados, conforme Hobson 2012).
  • Hobson RM, Saunders B, Ball G, Harris RC, Sale C. Amino Acids 2012;43(1):25-37. — n analisado no estudo de remo (8 β-alanina, 9 placebo).
  • Kern BD, Robinson TL. Effects of β-alanine supplementation on performance and body composition in collegiate wrestlers and football players. J Strength Cond Res 2011;25(7):1804-15. — nenhuma diferença significativa; conclusão do resumo positiva (spin).
  • Ashtary-Larky D, Bagheri R, Ghanavati M, et al. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2022;19(1):196-218. — MLG +0,05 kg (−0,71 a 0,82).
